Broken Arrow outdoor kitchen, built to host every weekend from the first warm Saturday through tailgate season. We just wrapped an investment-grade build in Forest Ridge: a Belgard Brighton wall-and-counter system framing a Blaze Professional LUX 32" grill, set on a Techo-Bloc Blu 60 paver floor over a compacted, Oklahoma-tough base that won't heave when the freeze-thaw cycle hits. Volt brass path and step lighting carry the space well past sunset. The detail we're proudest of: hand-cut mitered countertop corners, so there's not one exposed paver edge anywhere on the build. That's the line between a patio and a place your family actually lives.

This is our 14th build across the Broken Arrow metro this year — neighbors talk, and we built it right the first time.
